annotation.title_clean: Guidelines for Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Courts and Tribunals: Tribunal Members and Judicial Support Staff
annotation.title_en: Guidelines for Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Courts and Tribunals: Tribunal Members and Judicial Support Staff
annotation.summary_en: New Zealand judiciary guidelines (7 Dec 2023) for judges, tribunal members and support staff using generative AI chatbots. They cover understanding limitations, confidentiality, accuracy and accountability, bias, security, disclosure, and detecting GenAI use by lawyers and litigants. No embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Do not enter private, confidential, suppressed or privileged information into public GenAI chatbots
Users must verify accuracy of any GenAI output before relying on it
Judges need not disclose GenAI use; support staff should discuss use with supervising judge
Report unintentional disclosures and security breaches to supervisors or Ministry of Justice
GenAI use for legal analysis is not recommended; be alert to GenAI-generated submissions and deepfake evidence
